# dbpeek

Privacy-first SQL client. One npx command, nothing stored.

## What it is
A local-only database explorer. Running `npx dbpeek "postgres://..."`
opens your browser to a SQL editor with schema-aware autocomplete,
EXPLAIN plan visualization, ERD diagrams, inline cell editing, and
query history. Database credentials exist only in server process
memory and are freed when the process exits — nothing is written to
disk, and nothing is transmitted off the local machine.

## Supported databases
PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MSSQL.

## How to install
dbpeek requires no installation. Run it directly with npx, pnpm dlx,
or bunx:

```
npx dbpeek "postgres://user:pass@localhost:5432/mydb"
```

Node.js 18 or higher is required.
